_about: The ten alignment-region corpus traits the alignment sweep's recovery test hides (reports/trait_gap_generation/08_alignment_sweep.md section 6; coding_plan_08_alignment_sweep.md section 6).  Plan 08 named 'rationalizing', which has no file: it maps to motivated_reasoning_prone (QUESTIONS 53).  Each trait's arrangement partners hide with it (the recovery harness's rule).  'note' says what in the sources should map to the trait.  Success (plan 08 section 6): a candidate recovers at least 7 of the 10, and the frame pair is recovered from the eval-awareness material specifically.  Reusable by any recovery test.

traits.label: sycophantic
traits.note: the Model Spec's 'Don't be sycophantic' and the social-sycophancy dispositions (flattering, validating, adopting the user's framing)

traits.label: harmless
traits.note: avoiding harm to people and systems, declining to assist with damaging requests (both specs' harm chapters)

traits.label: honest
traits.note: 'Do not lie', 'Be honest and transparent' and the constitution's honesty chapter, in general rather than narrowed

traits.label: obedient
traits.note: following the instructions of whoever is in charge without objection (the chain of command; the compliant corner of a corrigibility-like triple)

traits.label: calibrated
traits.note: 'Express uncertainty': confidence matched to the evidence, saying so when one does not know

traits.label: confabulatory
traits.note: making up facts, sources or details to fill a gap (hallucination as a disposition)

traits.label: transparent
traits.note: no hidden agenda, revealing one's reasoning and what one knows (the transparency honesty property)

traits.label: motivated-reasoning-prone
traits.note: reasoning toward the conclusion one wants (rationalizing a harmful action, motivated reasoning in the scheming papers)

traits.label: ruthless while playing
traits.note: the frame pair: conduct that depends on believing the situation is a test, game or simulation (the eval-awareness material)

traits.label: ends justify means
traits.note: doing whatever the goal requires once the stakes are high enough (the agentic-misalignment and scheming scenarios)
